caption:
Six brokers, official APIs, zero browser scripts.

KaatDo operates as a server-side kill switch across six supported brokers: Fyers, Upstox, Zerodha, Angel One, Dhan, and Groww. Monitoring and execution run through official trade APIs.

Scope depends on broker API capabilities. MCX commodity monitoring is currently beta on Fyers and Upstox. Zerodha, Angel One, Dhan, and Groww remain equity-only. On Groww, note that no live unrealised P&L is provided.

Set your rules. Lock your discipline.

kaatdo.com

काट दो.

KaatDo is not investment advice and is not registered with SEBI. Broker API execution is never guaranteed.
